content.short: BoomFi helps businesses accept crypto payments, run recurring billing, and settle funds across supported networks.
content.description: BoomFi is a payments platform for businesses that want to accept cryptocurrency without building the full settlement and compliance stack in house. Its products include payment links, checkout, recurring crypto payments, fiat and crypto settlement options, and exchange or ramp services that can be embedded through APIs or lighter integrations. The platform also screens transactions for AML compliance and supports configurable settlement networks and currencies. Mantle merchants can use BoomFi to collect payments, manage subscriptions, and route funds through a more operationally ready workflow.
content.meta: BoomFi provides crypto checkout, billing, and settlement tools with Mantle support.
